name: Oplosaurus
isnote: Based on a single tooth; PBDB places it in Sauropoda.
sum: Oplosaurus is a sauropod from the Lower Cretaceous Wessex Formation of the Isle of Wight, England, named in 1852 from a tooth.
wsnote: Known from a tooth; no size figure.
biology: No biological statement was read in the sources consulted.
author: Gervais 1852
